common.resetFamily.title: Reset {name} examples
gallery.note: Host UI examples. Values and callback readouts are local to this view and reset when you leave. Send and Stop only simulate local state; they do not call a model. Dictation is real and uses your configured speech provider only when explicitly started.
family.pickers.title: Pickers
pickers.note: The model and thinking controls use the real host catalog. Their linked choices stay in this family; core defaults are not changed.
pickers.model.label: Model
pickers.thinking.label: Thinking for this model
pickers.knowledge.label: Knowledge selection
pickers.knowledge.note: Selection stays local to this demo. The host picker also offers source-management actions; those affect your real sources.
family.composer.title: Composer
composer.note: Send enters a local busy state and retains your draft. While busy with a nonempty draft, the host keeps Send available for steering. Clear the draft to expose Stop, or use Complete simulation, which is available throughout the busy state. Nothing is sent or saved.
composer.label: Independent composer
family.dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.note: Real dictation: explicitly choose Dictate or the microphone to use your configured speech provider. This can send audio to that provider and may incur cost. Nothing starts automatically. Finish awaits final transcript delivery; Cancel affects only this control's recording, not another owner.
dictation.label: Host dictation control
family.standardComposer.title: Standard composer
standardComposer.note: Independent local model, thinking and draft state. Send waits for final dictation delivery through the host API before this local simulation and retains your draft. While busy with a nonempty draft, the host keeps Send available for steering. Clear the draft to expose Stop, or use Complete simulation, which is available throughout the busy state. The microphone explicitly starts real dictation using your configured speech provider; it may send audio and incur cost.
standardComposer.label: Host standard composer
family.buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.note: The host button currently does not automatically show a pending or disabled style while an async callback awaits. This example's pending readout and Complete async example control are local to the demo.
buttons.icon.title: Add example ({size})
buttons.size.title: {size} size
buttons.badge.note: Badges use plugin-supplied text and a single color with a 15% background tint. These are static examples, not grading results.
family.settings.title: Settings rows
settings.note: All values stay local. Text must contain at least three non-space characters. Number and slider values must be whole numbers in their displayed range. Invalid edits are rejected by the host before onChange.

family.markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.note: Static host rendering: prose, code, table, math and Mermaid. No images, remote resources or model calls.
markdown.sample:
A **host-rendered** paragraph with *emphasis*, inline `code`, and a short list:

- Complete static content
- Built-in renderers only

```ts
const message: string = "Hello, gallery";
console.log(message);
```

| Example | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Local state | Ephemeral |
| Model calls | None |

Inline math: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.

$$
\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$

```mermaid
flowchart LR

```

family.workerResults.title: Worker results
workers.note: Twelve static examples: all four terminal statuses with all three presentations. No workers are started.
workers.label: Example worker
family.menus.title: Menus
menus.note: Enabled and disabled items, local selection, and preferred opening sides. The host owns positioning, dismissal, Escape and focus return.
family.dialogs.title: Dialogs
dialogs.note: Ordinary, long-scroll and nested host dialogs. Covered parents retain their local text and scroll. No plugin keyboard handlers or focus overrides are installed.
dialogs.contentNote: This is plugin-owned content inside the real host dialog. Use its X or Escape to close it.
dialogs.paragraph: Paragraph {index}. This static content makes the dialog scroll naturally. Scroll position belongs to this mounted dialog and remains intact while a child is open.
retained.label: Retained text
retained.description: Edit this before opening a child. Closing the child does not remount this field.
family.surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.note1: Open a nonmodal host surface over the current page body. Its page top bar or floating sidebar control stays outside; the sidebar and global dialogs remain available. Navigating away closes the surface.
surfaces.note2: The same demo is also available from a native teaching or practice session's UI Showcase surface top-bar action. Both include background presets, retained text, nested surfaces, and menus/dialogs above the surface. Escape and focus remain entirely host-owned.
surface.note: This real nonmodal host surface covers the page body, leaving its top bar or floating sidebar control outside. The sidebar and global dialogs remain available. Visible headings belong to this plugin; the host supplies only a floating X and an accessible name. Local text is retained while a nested surface covers it. Reset clears this demo's local examples and restores the dimmed background.
surface.nested.title: Nested UI Showcase surface
surface.nested.note: The parent remains mounted underneath. Close this surface with its host X or Escape, then check the parent's retained text. Menus and dialogs below open above this surface.
tree.note1: A small synthetic directory using the host tree. Shared item appears under both folders with independent occurrence keys. Selection is optional and never cascades from folders to children. Hiding selection preserves it; Reset clears this family's state.
tree.note2: Click a row, then use the host's arrow-row navigation; Space selects an enabled host checkbox. The editable draft keeps its normal input keys. This example owns its 36rem minimum width and horizontal scrolling, not a responsive tree engine.

tree.label: Directory example
